Interface RetrofitService

public interface RetrofitService
Optional marker interface that keeps a Retrofit service available after R8 shrinking.

Extend this interface to prevent R8 from removing or merging a service interface, even if it declares no HTTP methods or all its methods are removed as unused. The interface remains available for Retrofit.create(Class), while unused methods can still be removed. 

public interface TestService extends RetrofitService {}

TestService testService = retrofit.create(TestService.class);
